newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RAMS cut Australian home loan rate by 0.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: RAMS cut Australian home loan rate by 0.5 pct.

text.p: RAMS Home Loans said on Wednesday it has passed on the full 0.5 percentage point cut in official cash rates to its mortgage interest rate.
RAMS said it had cut its rate to 6.49 percent. The new rate would be effective from Wednesday for new borrowers, but existing customers would have to wait until August 15 for it to take effect.

"This cut in rates will benefit not only our existing customers and potential home buyers, but the economy overall," RAMS marketing director, Greg Jones said. "We are passing the full amount of this rate cut on to all our customers, who can
expect a significant reduction in their montly repayments."
The Reserve Bank of Australia earlier on Wednesday cut official cash rate by 0.5 of a percentage point to 5.0 percent, the fifth cut in a year.
